## Summary

Quantum Forge builds next-generation simulation and compute orchestration platforms for
semiconductor design and advanced manufacturing clients. We are a synthetic JD fixture used to
test the resume pipeline against the Workday portal shape. Do not treat as a real role.

We are hiring a Staff Platform Engineer to join our Austin headquarters. This is a technical
leadership role with direct responsibility for the reliability, scalability, and security of
our compute infrastructure. You will serve as the senior technical voice for platform
decisions across engineering and will work closely with infrastructure, security, and product
teams to evolve our internal developer platform.

## Responsibilities

- Lead the design and evolution of our Kubernetes-based compute platform serving internal and
  external workloads across multiple AWS regions
- Own infrastructure-as-code practices and drive adoption of Terraform modules across all
  engineering teams
- Define and enforce platform SLOs and lead root cause analysis for significant production incidents
- Partner with security to implement zero-trust networking, IAM policy governance, and audit
  logging standards across the cloud footprint
- Drive the internal developer platform roadmap including self-service tooling, templating, and
  golden-path provisioning flows
- Mentor senior engineers on platform reliability principles and infrastructure best practices
- Evaluate and adopt observability tooling to improve MTTR and system-wide visibility

## Required Skills

- 7+ years of infrastructure or platform engineering with significant production Kubernetes ownership
- Expert-level Terraform including module composition, remote state, and multi-environment patterns
- Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, storage, identity, and managed services
- Proficiency in Go for building internal platform tooling, controllers, and automation scripts
- Strong grasp of observability fundamentals including distributed tracing, metrics pipelines, and
  structured logging using OpenTelemetry or equivalent
- Experience implementing and operating service mesh solutions such as Istio or Linkerd in
  production clusters
- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including VPC design, DNS, TLS, and load balancing
- Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct authority
- Strong written communication for architecture documents, postmortems, and cross-team alignment

## Preferred

- Experience operating GPU or high-performance compute workloads on Kubernetes
- Familiarity with eBPF-based tooling for observability or network policy enforcement
- Background in platform product management or internal developer experience metrics
- CNCF project contributions or presentations at KubeCon or similar venues

## Compensation

$200,000 – $260,000 base salary + equity + annual bonus + relocation assistance

Benefits include full family medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) with company match,
paid parental leave, annual hardware refresh budget, and access to our on-site fitness center
and catered lunch in Austin. This is a fully on-site role — we believe platform engineering
benefits from daily in-person collaboration and rapid iteration.

## About Quantum Forge

Quantum Forge provides simulation infrastructure for companies designing the next generation of
chips, sensors, and advanced materials. Our platform runs billions of simulation jobs annually
and our compute orchestration layer is mission-critical for our customers.

We are post-Series C with a strong ARR base and significant contracts with US defense-adjacent
manufacturing clients. Engineering is the center of the company and platform reliability is
non-negotiable. If you care about building infrastructure that other engineers depend on and
take pride in zero-downtime deployments and elegant architecture, you will thrive here.

Quantum Forge is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination of any kind.
